meta_title: Taller Martínez — IT support for local businesses in Torrevieja, Alicante & Murcia
meta_description: The IT support your local business can rely on, in Torrevieja, Alicante province and the Region of Murcia. Websites, data, backups, social media and AI — handled by one person.
hero_h1: The IT guy your business can rely on.
hero_lead: Websites, data, backups and social media — handled by one person. No jargon, and right on your doorstep.
problem_title: Your job is running your business, not the tech.
problem_intro: And yet everything depends on it working — the website, the socials, the data. When it goes wrong, you're the one left wrestling with dashboards and warnings that aren't your problem to solve.
problem_pain_0: The website's been down or out of date for months.
problem_pain_1: No backups — until the day you need them.
problem_pain_2: The socials haven't been touched since last summer.
problem_pain_3: You're paying for software and nobody's quite sure what it's for.
services_intro: Everything technical, handled by one person. Take what you need.
services_item_0_titulo: AI, put to work for you
services_item_0_desc: The same AI the big players use, working for you instead: an assistant that answers your customers, content for your socials, or the tedious paperwork handled on its own. No hype, explained in plain English.
services_item_1_desc: Websites, online shops and custom apps. From a landing page that brings in customers to an in-house tool that saves you hours.
services_item_2_desc: Backups that actually work, your files in order, and data protection done properly. So one bad day doesn't wipe out years of work.
services_item_3_desc: Social media, content and ads that actually get seen. You show up where your customers are, without having to wrestle with Meta Business.
services_item_4_desc: Which tool to use, how to digitise that process, why you're paying for three apps that do the same thing. I explain it jargon-free and you decide.
how_intro: A small operation, straight-talking, and work done properly — start to finish, with my name on it.
how_item_0_desc: No call centres, no ticket numbers. The technical side is handled by one person, the same one from start to finish: me.
how_item_1_desc: I explain things in plain English so you can decide with the full picture. No small print, no hype.
how_item_2_desc: A fixed quote before we start. You know what you're paying and why — no surprises at the end of the month.
how_item_3_desc: Based in Torrevieja, I work across Alicante province and the Region of Murcia. If it helps we meet in person; if not, I'll call you all the same.
about_title: I'm just starting out. That works in your favour.
about_body_html: I'm Alberto Martínez, eight years building software. I've just set up Taller Martínez to look after local businesses — which means one thing for you: my full attention and down-to-earth pricing. You won't get lost in a crowd of clients.
about_project_0_desc: A Telegram bot with inline search, navigation and a word of the day. Thousands of lookups served.
about_project_1_desc: A personal finance app I'm building: accounts, budgets and net worth, all in one place.
about_project_2_desc: My personal software workshop: projects, open source and the more technical side of what I do.
contact_intro: No obligation. Drop me a line, we'll talk it through, and I'll tell you straight whether I can help and what it'd cost.
